How booking works

  1. Choose the service you want and tap Book.
  2. Enter your name, pick a date and choose a session.
  3. Tap Book now. Your booking goes straight to the arena by email, and we will contact you.

Questions people ask

How do I book?

Tap Book under the service you want, fill in your name, phone number, date and session, then tap Book now. The arena gets your booking straight away.

Can I book more than one service?

Yes. Each service has its own booking, so book each one you want.

What if I need to change my booking?

Call or WhatsApp us on 0812 099 4806 and we will help you.

Can I come with friends and family?

Yes. Astro Soccer Arena is a place to enjoy together.
